title: Healthcare Recruiter
description:
Healthcare Recruiter

Location: Remote (Midwest Focus- ideally recruiter sits in IN, KY, or OH)
Compensation: 50k Base + Commission | Full Benefits
Company: LER Healthcare

About Us
At LER Healthcare, our mission is to Humanify Healthcare — partnering with organizations to build workforce solutions that put people first. We provide traditional staffing services and innovative workforce strategies that help organizations attract, retain, and optimize their clinical talent. We're disrupting an industry that's overdue for change, and we're looking for builders to join us.

The Role
We're seeking a high-energy, solutions-oriented Healthcare Recruiter to help us grow our clinician network across the Midwest (Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky). You'll focus in Behavioral Health. This isn't a "post and pray” job — it's a hunting role. You'll source, network, and build relationships with both active and passive job seekers. You'll play a critical role in ensuring our candidates are aligned with client needs, qualified for open roles, and supported throughout their journey.

What You'll Do

  • Proactively source and recruit healthcare professionals through calls, texts, social platforms, and referrals

  • Build and manage a strong candidate pipeline across across key behavioral health roles (social workers, LPNs, RNs, behavioral health techs, counselors/therapists)

  • Screen candidates, gather information, and build profiles to ensure qualifications match client needs

  • Submit candidates to open roles quickly and accurately

  • Manage candidate relationships through compliance, onboarding, and their assignments

  • Contribute to the growth of a startup environment where agility, creativity, and execution matter

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of recruiting or sales experience (healthcare preferred)

  • Proven ability to hunt, network, and drive pipeline activity

  • Self-starter mentality — thrives in a fast-paced, build-as-we-go environment

  • Strong communication skills and relationship-building instincts

  • Solutions-based mindset with high energy and ownership

What This Is NOT
If you're looking for a corporate environment with the Cadillac of tools, layers of support, and a punch-the-clock rhythm — this isn't it. We're a startup. We move fast, think big, and expect the same from our team.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + uncapped commission

  • Full benefits

  • 100% remote (no hybrid mandates)

  • A mission-driven team that values impact and performance equally

title: Registered Nurse
description:
Job Description


Responsibilities

When you are an employee at LER Healthcare, you will find real meaning and purpose in your work. Because of the care we provide, more people choose LER Healthcare for their health care needs than any other system in the community. Client a health care career designed with you in mind.

LER Healthcare is now offering Registered Nurses flexible scheduling, PRN shifts, and competitive pay while being a part of the Norton Healthcare team.

LER Healthcare staffs all 9 of our facilities in Louisville, Kentucky and Southern Indiana. We currently have these options available:

  • Norton Audubon Hospital
  • Norton Brownsboro Hospital
  • Norton Children's Hospital
  • Norton Clark Hospital
  • Norton Hospital
  • Norton King's Daughters' Hospital
  • Norton Scott Hospital
  • Norton West Louisville Hospital
  • Norton Women's & Children's Hospital

RN PRN Float positions offer:

  • Opportunity to earn $47 an hour plus qualifying shift differential
  • Opportunity to float within our 9 of our facilities in Louisville, Kentucky and Southern Indiana
  • Assignments in both adult and pediatric units based on experience
  • Flexible self scheduling employment options

To discuss our LER Healthcare options for RNs, please apply to this posting or contact us at Recruitment@LerHealthcare.com .


Qualifications

Required:

  • 2 years acute care RN experience OR one year of acute-care RN experience and 2 years of acute-care LPN experience
  • Diploma or Associate Nursing
  • Registered Nurse (KY & IN)
  • Must have and maintain an active Compact/Multistate RN license or active RN licensure in both KY and IN
